tvShow.name: North of North
tvShow.overview: A young Inuk woman wants to build a new future for herself after a spontaneous and extremely public exit from her marriage. It won't be easy in a small Arctic town where everybody knows your business.

episodes.name: Top of the World
episodes.overview: Feeling stuck in her life in her tiny Arctic community, Siaja decides it's time to shake things up during the annual Spring Festival, but her plans are derailed by personal upheavals.

episodes.name: No Freeloading
episodes.overview: Siaja struggles to pick up the pieces and prove herself capable of handling more than just her messy personal life.

episodes.name: Dumpcano
episodes.overview: Siaja’s first day of work goes awry when she accidentally starts a fire at the dump and Alistair and Kuuk visit the community center to discuss Ice Cove's candidacy to host a polar research station.

episodes.name: Joy to the Effing World
episodes.overview: With Kuuk’s help, Siaja forms a plan to shake up Elder’s night by coaxing children to attend, hoping to raise the Elders’ spirits. Meanwhile, Neevee seems to run into Alistair everywhere she goes.

episodes.name: Walrus Dick Baseball
episodes.overview: Ice Cove is shortlisted for the polar research station, so Siaja proposes they host a baseball fundraiser to afford upgrades to the community centre to better their chances. Helen is coerced into a winner-takes-all bet by the rival town’s leader.

episodes.name: Carnivores
episodes.overview: Love is not in the air in Ice Cove as Siaja re-enters the dating world in epic style, Neevee and Alistair reach a turning point, and Kuuk has a surprise visitor.

episodes.name: Lost and Found
episodes.overview: The community comes together for an exhausting multi-day search for Ting. Siaja entrusts Alistair to babysit Bun during the search.

episodes.name: Bad Influences
episodes.overview: Siaja and Helen put the final touches on their pitch for the polar research station, when Helen is pulled away. Siaja uses this opportunity to view the only available apartment in town with Kuuk’s help.

episodes.name: I Wanna Mask Dance With Somebody
episodes.overview: It's winter in Ice Cove and young single mother Siaja is trying to adjust. She organizes a mask dance to boost tourism and it spirals into chaos. Meanwhile, a mysterious discovery in Neevee's house raises a lot of questions.

episodes.name: Ice, Ice, Baby
episodes.overview: Siaja turns to Alistair to help her solve a sudden water crisis, Neevee applies for a grant to grow her store while Siaja's Winter Ball idea is approved. Mother and daughter are dreaming big, with important projects to thrown themselves into.

alternativeTitles.title: К северу от севера, Крайний север
